notes.title: Daily/Weekly Challenges are in!
notes.content:
- Adds Daily and Weekly challenge modes
- Adds Hardcore variants of each (these score you, and are one try per day/week ONLY... so probs practice the day or week's map a bit first)
- Fixes the Punched A Dude achievement, you should get it now
- Fixes the issue where a fresh install started with a handful of upgrades already unlocked
- Updates localization (everything is now localized properly)
- Fixes occasional bug where you'd take damage during Meow Max cutscene

Most of these changes are just migrating over from Unstable, though I also added the fix for the cutscene damage (and fixed a few issues with the localization).

notes.title: We're out! Now to make it EVEN BETER.
notes.content:
Hola folks! Just a short update on where we go from here. Like it says in the FAQ, we'll be trying for a 2-update-a-month pattern, doing that minor major trade-off approach, though this first week or two will be a little more rapid and responsive.

Right now, here's what we're looking at for a patch very soon. We're just waiting on localization, and then we can do:
[list]
    [*]Daily Challenge and Weekly Challenge modes (with hardcore variants)
    [*]Localization patches (there's some tutorial strings that aren't in loc, etc)
    [*]Assorted stability/etc fixes
    [*]Exposing the credits so you don't have to beat the game to see them
    [*]We may (MAY) make the Dude Level... do something. Secret.
[/list]

We're sweeping player requests and feedback into a backlog of tasks, so by all means, pop by the forums and tell us what you're digging or not digging, or what you're hoping to see moving forward.

You can ALSO reach us on Discord, here: https://discordapp.com/invite/GKjrNbR (I'm @glassbottommeg over there or on Twitter, by all means, say hi!)
